name: GoodTherapy
short_description: Paid therapist directory whose membership tiers bundle a listing with continuing-education credits and, on the top tier, practice tools.
long_description: GoodTherapy is a long-running paid directory. Basic ($30.95/month) is a listing and profile; Premium ($40.95/month) adds unlimited continuing-education credits; Pro ($49.95/month) adds FrontDesk booking, client portal and billing. Group practices get 25% off. Annual plans are paid upfront and auto-renew. All listed therapists are paying members.
one_liner: A directory listing that doubles as a CE subscription.
best_for: Clinicians who need CE credits and want a listing bundled in (Premium)
A second paid directory alongside Psychology Today
Group practices that can use the 25% group discount
Solo clinicians who would use FrontDesk scheduling instead of a separate tool
not_for: Clinicians who want a free listing
Clinicians who already have an EHR and get CE elsewhere (Premium and Pro would duplicate costs)
Anyone needing a confirmed BAA for FrontDesk before using it

notes.solo-therapist: Basic listing at $30.95/month; Premium ($40.95) adds unlimited CE credits, which can replace a separate CE subscription.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.description: Premium plus FrontDesk booking, client portal and billing.

pricing.notes: 25% off for group practices. Annual plans auto-renew.

compliance.notes: Listing is not PHI. BAA status for the FrontDesk tools is not published.

seo.title: GoodTherapy Therapist Directory | HeyPsych
seo.meta_description: GoodTherapy directory review. Therapist listing with ethical focus. $29.95/month. Alternative to Psychology Today.

faqs.a: GoodTherapy professional listings cost $29.95 per month, comparable to Psychology Today.
Both are therapist directories at similar prices. Psychology Today has more traffic and provider listings. GoodTherapy emphasizes ethical practice standards and client education.
